## What this deploys

One `google_cloud_run_v2_service` (`beam4pm-pro` in
`us-central1`) running `ghcr.io/seanchatmangpt/beam4pm:latest`
on port 8080, with 1 CPU /
512Mi memory per instance and scaling bounds
0..3 instances,
plus (only when `allow_unauthenticated = true`; currently
`false`) an `allUsers` →
`roles/run.invoker` IAM member. Nothing else: no secrets, no domain
mappings, no service-account minting -- those are separate, deliberate
decisions, not side effects of a deploy module.
